mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% compresses risk-free rates, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors seek yield in equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 10.0% signals labor market deterioration that precedes corporate earnings contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 10.0% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicates accelerating labor market contraction that triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint negative effect of PAYEMS decline and UNRATE rise fails to predict negative 5-day returns in more than 50% of cases (Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) increase discount rates and reduce liquidity, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as equity valuations adjust to higher financing costs.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 95.0 indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output capacity, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as earnings expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO falls below 95.0 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1,000.0 (thousands of units) signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through improved corporate revenue outlooks.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1000.0 over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate below 5.0% during late-cycle expansion signals labor market tightness that triggers wage inflation and Fed policy tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is below 5.0% over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust economic momentum that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint positive effect of RSAFS and HOUST fails to predict positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of cases (Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling window).
